title: Accencention SMP
description: A server that foucses on pvp and stuff like that it has tpa, home and the ranked smp plugin to keep things fun😀 AND NO PAY TO WIN CONTENT
body:
👑 Ascension SMP

Rise Above. Dominate the Ranks
Welcome to Ascension SMP, a mostly vanilla Minecraft experience Built around the Ranked SMP system, you'll climb the ranks, form alliances, and much more
⚔️ Competitive Ranked PvP

Gain and lose rank points through player combat.
Climb the leaderboard and prove you're the strongest player on the server.

🕶️ NO name shown while invis

kill players while invisible and keep your identity hidden in chat.
 🎨 Qol fetures

/sethome to quickly return to your base.
/tpa for easy travel and meeting up with friends.
VeinMiner to make mining faster and save time
 
🏠 Create Teams

Form teams with friends.
Build massive bases and defend your land.

🌎 Mostly Vanilla Survival

No overpowered custom items.
No pay-to-win advantages.
Just classic Minecraft survival enhanced with selected features.

if you want to turn on the server than go to the disc and il get me or jisnt to give you perms
